wayland-protocols

The Linux app's runner (linux/runner/wayland/) holds the client code of two Wayland protocols, as
wayland-scanner writes it from the descriptions in wayland-protocols: pointer constraints and
relative pointer (both "unstable v1"). The app uses them for relative mouse on a remote screen
under Wayland. Both carry this notice.
